propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy type-specific shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contract, allowing padded plans to pass without required sections
Clarity measurement logic is duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py, creating drift risk when extending deterministic checks

Documented plan-writing guidance and active acceptance-criteria requirements diverge on Success Criteria (collapsed into AC per epic 1386) and rejected-alternative prose (conflicting guidance between author guide and G6 criterion)
Deterministic checks cannot reliably assess Testing section applicability, persona/problem quality, mechanism correctness, or alternative rationale, which should remain LLM-reviewed

Seven recommended mechanically-testable additions (required-section shape, AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, grounded edit-set, AC text hygiene, Testing shape markers, structural nonempty checks) can be unified into a per-check evidence model without accumulating filler compensation
